title: Legal pages
summary: Legal notice, privacy, terms of use and terms of sale. Footer only — never in the shop info menu. Kernel owns the React routes.

blocks.title: Page plugin
blocks.text: plugin.json kind page, route /legal. No nav.key: legal documents stay in the footer only (legal notice, privacy, terms of use, terms of sale) — never the shop info menu. Disable and the plugin drops out of the sitemap listing; footer links stay so the documents remain reachable. React for home, about, legal, and sizes lives in the kernel; this package is the enablement and SEO listing.

items.description: /legal (legal notice). /privacy, /terms and /sales-terms are the other documents in this plugin's copy pack.
While Sitemap pages is on, the kernel lists this route on seo.sitemap.entries. Extra paths that are not this route must register the filter yourself (Guides does /pose and /capsules).
